description: This file is a MongoDB initialization script written in JavaScript. It defines functions to create collections with schema validation, sets up collections for users, conversations, schemes, vector embeddings, and audit logs, and creates indexes to optimize queries. The script is intended to be run in the MongoDB shell to initialize the database schema for the Maharashtra AI Agents Platform.

methods.name: ensureCollection
methods.description: Helper function to create a collection with a validator if it doesn't exist, or update the validator if it does.
